instruction: Move the yellow triangle to the bottom-right corner of the image.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the yellow triangle to the bottom-right corner. The evaluator exports the image and checks if the triangle centroid is in the bottom-right quadrant (x > 2/3 * width AND y > 2/3 * height).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the exported image from VM (getters/gimp.py:4-27)
Metric correctly filters yellow pixels using appropriate RGB range [180-255, 180-255, 0-120] (metrics/gimp.py:31-41)
Position verification logic correctly checks if triangle centroid is in bottom-right quadrant (x > 2/3 width AND y > 2/3 height) (metrics/gimp.py:70)
Includes reasonable sanity checks for pixel count ratio (0.001 < ratio < 0.5) to detect potential detection failures (metrics/gimp.py:53-59)
Postconfig properly exports the image via Shift+Ctrl+E before verification, ensuring fresh state
Comprehensive error handling and logging for debugging (metrics/gimp.py:72-84)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Yellow color range could potentially miss edge cases (very light or dark yellows), but is appropriate for typical GIMP yellow objects
Minor: Centroid-based position checking could theoretically pass if triangle is heavily weighted toward bottom-right but extends across image, though this is unlikely in practice
Minor: No shape validation to confirm detected object is triangle-shaped, but instruction assumes pre-existing yellow triangle in image
